summary: apt_repository's validate_certs option controls SSL certificate validation for the repository and should only be disabled for self-signed personal sites.
questions: How do I add a repo with a self-signed HTTPS certificate?

answer_card.title: apt_repository validate_certs
answer_card.answer_md: `validate_certs` (default yes): set `false` to skip SSL validation of the repo. Only use on personally controlled sites with self-signed certs.
